At Teleflex, we are empowering the future of healthcare. For more information, please visit teleflex.com.**Position Summary**

As an AI Data Scientist within the Enterprise Analytics team, you will be a key driver in transforming Teleflex into an AI\-empowered organization. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, advanced analytics, and business strategy, supporting global functions including Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Finance.  

Your primary mission is to evolve our existing reporting ecosystem (Power BI/Tableau) by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs). You will build intelligent interfaces that allow stakeholders to interact with complex data via natural language, effectively "training" AI to navigate report trees and deliver instant, actionable insights.**Principal Responsibilities**
* AI Integration: Design and deploy LLM\-based solutions that allow users to query enterprise reports (Power BI/Tableau) using natural language.
* Predictive Modelling: Develop and maintain machine learning models to optimize global operations across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance.
* Advanced Analytics: Translate complex business problems into mathematical frameworks to drive efficiency in Procurement, Regulatory, and Quality functions.
* Insight Automation: Build "Drill\-Through" AI logic that enables non\-technical users to move from high\-level KPIs to root\-cause analysis via conversational interfaces.
* Data Storytelling: Create and enhance sophisticated dashboards in Power BI and Tableau, ensuring data integrity and user\-centric design.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Act as a bridge between the Enterprise Analytics team and global functional leads to identify opportunities for AI\-driven automation.
* Facilitate quarterly standards review with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Build cascading meeting network (weekly service/monthly supply) to embed behaviours and sustain outcomes.
**Education / Experience Requirements**
* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Preferred: Master’s or PhD in a specialized AI/Machine Learning discipline or an MBA with a heavy focus on Business Analytics.
**Specialized Skills / Other Requirements**
* Technical Stack: Expert\-level proficiency in Python (specifically libraries like Pandas, Scikit\-learn, NLP and PyTorch/TensorFlow).
* Generative AI: Proven experience with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models).
* Visualization: Advanced skills in Power BI and/or Tableau, including DAX or Tableau Calculation language.
* Functional Expertise: 3\+ years of experience performing analytics within Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, or Commercial environments.
* Data Plumbing: Strong SQL skills and a deep understanding of data modelling.
* Nice to have: Prior experience with SAP (ERP) data structures is highly desirable.
* Excel Mastery: Ability to manipulate and validate data in Excel for rapid prototyping.

  


**Key Relationships / Interfaces:**  

* Global Supply Chain
* Global Procurement
* Global Manufacturing
* Global Finance
  


**Behaviours \& Values:**  

* Curiosity: A natural drive to explore "why" a trend is happening, not just "what" the data shows.
* Pragmatism: A focus on building AI tools that solve real business problems, rather than just chasing "shiny" technology.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in the highly regulated environment of medical devices where data accuracy and quality are paramount.
* Collaborative Spirit: The ability to explain complex AI concepts to a Finance or Regulatory stakeholder without using jargon.
* Integrity: Commitment to ethical AI practices and data privacy.
  


**WORKING ENVIRONMENT:**  

* Office/Professional (Hybrid)

**TRAVEL REQUIRED:** Approx 10% travel required

Diversity fosters innovative thinking and entrepreneurship and that’s what we are about at Teleflex. We trust and value our people and their diversity and we make it fun to work here. We are on a journey to ensure our workplaces mirror the patients we serve and the communities we operate in. Our approach is simple, we embrace everyone and want them to feel they belong here. Come join a company where diversity is sought out and inclusivity is how we progress.

title: Project Manager
description:
### **Description**

  

Everything happens somewhere \- which is why spatial analytics is fundamental to companies trying to understand the “where” and the “why” of their business. CARTO is the world's leading cloud\-native spatial analysis platform, built to break down the silos of traditional GIS. Trusted by data scientists, analysts, and developers from global brands such as IKEA, Coca\-Cola, T\-Mobile, Swiss Re, and AXA, CARTO enables organizations to run scalable spatial analysis directly on their cloud data warehouse. Providing insights for critical use cases like site selection, catastrophe modeling, network planning, and supply chain optimization.
  

Built by a diverse team of over 150 people across the US, APAC, and Europe, CARTO's cloud\-native Agentic GIS platform provides a modern, future\-proof alternative to legacy GIS. Offering a powerful suite of tools for visualization, analytics, and application development, our platform is redefining how companies work with location data. CARTO (backed by Insight Partners, Accel Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and Earlybird Ventures, among others) is fundamentally changing the way location data is analyzed, making it an integrated and accessible part of modern business intelligence.  

At CARTO, we believe spatial context is one of the most underutilized dimensions in modern data platforms. While companies have become extremely sophisticated at analyzing *what* and *when*, very few truly leverage the power of *where*.  

CARTO is the leading cloud\-native Location Intelligence platform, built for the modern data stack. Instead of extracting data into legacy GIS systems, we extend the spatial capabilities of today’s leading cloud data warehouses — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, and Redshift — enabling organizations to run advanced geospatial analytics directly where their data already lives.  

We are redefining what “GIS” means in a warehouse\-native world. CARTO is not just a product company — our Professional Services team operates at the frontier of spatial data engineering. We design and deliver production\-grade geospatial architectures for enterprise customers across insurance, retail, logistics, climate risk, financial services and beyond. We work where data engineering, cloud architecture and geospatial science intersect.  

**What we are looking for:** We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to help us deliver complex, enterprise\-grade geospatial solutions built natively on modern cloud data platforms. You will work directly with our engineering teams on this process to deliver production\-ready systems for large customers.  

**Location:** This is a remote\-first role, open to candidates based **anywhere in Spain**. We have offices in Madrid and Seville if you prefer to work in person or want a place to collaborate occasionally, but there's no expectation to use them.### **You will**

  

* Lead stimulating, multi\-workstream enterprise projects end\-to\-end (scope, timeline, budget, governance, risk).
* Act as the main point of contact for customer stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Define and implement project governance frameworks (steering committees, reporting cadence, RAID logs).
* Create new value propositions. Our clients expect a level of innovation that they don't have internally.
* Identify risks early and drive mitigation plans proactively.
* Continuously improve our delivery methodology and internal best practices.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (Solutions Engineers, Data Scientists, Customer Success, Sales).
* Work hard and have fun!

  

### **You offer**

  

* 5\+ years of expertise managing software or data\-driven projects in SaaS, cloud, analytics, or consulting environments.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-level implementations with multiple stakeholders and high visibility.
* Experience working with analytics, BI, or geospatial solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing budgets, scope control, and commercial impact
* A collaborative work style that can thrive in a flexible, fluid operating environment
* Great communication and people skills
* A positive mindset. You’re self\- motivated with a sense of urgency in executing and delivering growth. You run quickly with little supervision
* Most of all, you are optimistic, data\-driven, smart, and eager to learn!
* Fluency in English and Spanish

**Nice to have*** Background in GIS, Location Intelligence, or spatial analytics.
* Experience in consulting or professional services organizations.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification.
* Experience managing distributed or international teams.

  

### **We offer**

  

* Compensation based on experience, discussed transparently during the process plus an annual bonus of up to 10% based on company objectives
* Contribute to a platform used by top companies around the world. Your work will have a direct impact on our users and clients
* Access to our Employee Stock Options Plan
* Private Medical Insurance
* Flexible compensation
* Education stipend
* Remote work stipend
* English classes
* A big vision: to help the world use location\-based data to make better decisions. We believe that openness and sustainability are baked into this vision, and we’re sharing it with the world.
* The opportunity to work with leading companies that want to solve challenging localization problems.

  

### **About CARTO**


We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.

Lead end\-to\-end data science workflows \- from data ingestion and feature engineering through to model development, deployment and optimisation.
  
Develop and implement advanced machine learning, statistical and predictive analytics solutions integrated into clinical and business processes.
  
Collaborate with clinical and executive stakeholders to define requirements and deliver dashboards, reports and analytic products aligned to customer needs.
  
Mentor team members and champion best practice data science methodologies, governance and standards across the organisation.

You are an experienced and strategic data science leader who thrives in complex environments and is passionate about using data to improve health system performance. You have:
  
  

A tertiary qualification in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline (postgraduate qualifications highly regarded).
  
Strong expertise in machine learning, statistical modelling, data transformation and working with large, disparate datasets using tools such as Python, R and SQL.
  
Proven ability to design and deliver BI dashboards and analytic products (experience with Qlik or Power BI highly regarded).
  
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data insights into meaningful outcomes for clinicians and executives.

**About the opportunities**



AUSTRAC, Australia’s financial intelligence agency and anti\-money laundering and terrorism financing regulator, is undergoing major transformation to strengthen its role in fighting financial crime. As we evolve and embrace these changes, we are now recruiting multiple roles across the Operational Analytics branch. We are seeking data science and advanced analytics professionals to support operational, regulatory and intelligence outcomes across the agency. We are looking for collaborative, proactive individuals who are innovative and passionate about harnessing the power of data. Our data teams generate vital insights that drive business intelligence and play a crucial role in advancing AUSTRAC's mission.


**Position**

We are currently seeking data science and advanced analytics professionals with qualifications and capabilities to fill the following roles:


* **Senior Data Scientist (EL1\)**
* **Data Scientist (APS6\)**



This recruitment process will not only fill current vacancies but also build a merit pool for future roles over the next 18 months. If you’re ready to bring your expertise and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.  

  

**Duties**

Depending on the role and classification level, you may be expected to:


* Design, develop and deliver data science and advanced analytics solutions that support operational and regulatory decision\-making.
* Apply statistical, mathematical and machine learning techniques to large, complex datasets to generate insights that inform priorities and action.
* Work across the end\-to\-end analytics lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration through to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement of analytical products.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational problems into data\-driven solutions and communicate findings clearly to technical and non?technical audiences.
* Contribute to strong analytics governance, data quality, and best practice across the Operational Analytics function.


* Support capability uplift through collaboration, knowledge sharing and, at senior levels, technical leadership and mentoring.

  

**Key Capabilities for success**  

  

**Qualifications:** Relevant Tertiary Qualification or Certification in one or the following disciplines is desirable i.e. (Data Science, Statistics or Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or related analytical discipline.)


**Skills and Experience:** While we value qualifications, we are open to candidates with strong experience, knowledge, and skills in one or more of the following:


* Delivering data science or advanced analytics solutions using statistical, mathematical or machine learning techniques.
* Programming in Python or similar languages, with experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Using big\-data or large\-scale processing technologies (e.g. PySpark or similar) and strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
* Communicating complex analytical insights through clear narratives, visualisations and reports to support decision\-making.


  

**For more detailed role duties and information about the capabilities we're looking for, please refer to the linked Candidate Pack. This can also be found through our** **AUSTRAC \- Jobs List****.**  

**Eligibility**


* To be eligible for this role you:
* Must be an Australian citizen at the time you apply.
* Will need to undertake AUSTRAC’s pre\-engagement checks.
* Will need to obtain and maintain an ongoing Negative Vetting Level 1 Security Clearance.

  

**Affirmative Measures**  

This vacancy is being advertised concurrently under a general round, an affirmative measures disability and an affirmative measures indigenous round.  

Evidence of eligibility will be requested if your application progresses under an affirmative measures process.  

Please indicate in your application if you are applying under Affirmative Measures, by ticking the relevant box in the application form.  

  

**Why AUSTRAC?**  

**Flexible, hybrid work environment:** We are committed to providing flexibility in working arrangements to recognise the importance of balancing work commitments with family, caring and other personal commitments of employees outside of work. AUSTRAC currently operates under a hybrid work arrangement.  

**Generous Leave Entitlements** including NAIDOC leave, parental leave, cultural leave, compassionate leave, carers leave, blood donation leave and community work leave.  

**Diversity and Inclusion:** Our core values of diversity, inclusion, and integrity drive everything we do. We actively encourage applications from Indigenous Australians, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and those of mature age. We recognise that united behaviours and mindsets will support our agency today and guide us into the future.  

**Mission Driven:** Make an impact at Australia’s anti\-money laundering and counter terrorism financing regulator and financial intelligence unit. We offer you a challenging and rewarding career with meaningful work.  

  

**Closing Date and Notes**  

Applications close at **11:30 pm AEDT on Tuesday 17 March 2026\.**  

For enquiries, please contact: Will 03 8636 0922\.  

  

*AUSTRAC is conducting a bulk recruitment process to fill roles for teams across the Operational Analytics Branch. This process will be used to establish a merit pool to fill current and future vacancies. The merit pools established from this merit\-based process will be valid for 18 months from the date of advertising. This merit pool may be used throughout this period to fill similar positions in the event positions become vacant.*

title: Senior Consultant ( Digital)
description:
**Company Description** **Who is Turner \& Townsend?**


All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**


The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:** We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:** We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:** We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice.

 **Job Description**  

We’re seeking an experienced Digital Senior Consultant (5\+ years) to deliver a range of services to our clients including, digital strategy, data management, system deployments, reporting and analytics. To deliver these services you will need to blend technical capability with a consulting skillset. As part of this role, you will need to define key commission deliverables, be confident enough to engage directly with senior client stakeholders and manage small teams of junior consultants to drive service excellence and client outcomes.


It is preferred if you have had experience delivering large scale data and digital transformation initiatives, experience within the construction/ property industry is seen as advantageous. The technical experience required to effectively deliver in this role includes activities typically performed by experienced business analysts or senior data scientists. Your technical capability will need to be complimented with a foundation in consulting, these skills will include, diagnostic analysis, report development, stakeholder engagement and strategic planning. As part of this role, you will need to be active in driving business generation initiatives, this includes networking, lead generation, tender responses and securing commission extensions.


This role is perfect for someone who loves connecting business objectives with technical solutions—hands\-on enough to develop and deliver, senior enough to mentor, and commercial enough to help win work.

 **Key Responsibilities**


Digital Strategy \& Advisory

* Assess client digital maturity and define roadmaps covering data, platforms, integrations, and change management.
* Translate business goals into pragmatic solution architectures, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Facilitate discovery workshops and produce strategy artefacts (current/future state, gap analysis, sequencing, RACI).


Data Management \& Architecture

* Design and implement data models, pipelines, and governance frameworks (quality, lineage, security, MDM).
* Establish data standards, metadata management, and retention/compliance practices (incl. privacy\-by\-design).


System Deployments \& Integration

* Support/ Lead end\-to\-end platform deployments (e.g., CRM/ERP, CDP, marketing clouds, data platforms).
* Oversee API\-based integrations, identity/access control, and environment readiness (Dev/Test/Prod).
* Manage implementation partners and ensure delivery against scope, budget, and timelines.


Reporting, Dashboarding \& Analytics

* Define KPI frameworks and deliver executive dashboards and self\-service BI.
* Implement data visualization best practices and model datasets for usability and performance.
* Drive analytics use\-cases (attribution, segmentation, forecasting, performance optimization).


Team Leadership \& Delivery Excellence

* Lead and mentor a junior consulting team; set standards, review deliverables, and nurture capability growth.
* Own project delivery governance: RAID logs, sprint reviews, stakeholder updates, and change control.
* Champion documentation quality, operational handover, and ongoing support frameworks.

  

Business Generation

* Support opportunity discovery, scoping, solution design, proposals, and demos.
* Support the development of new service propositions and marketing.
* Contribute to thought leadership (case studies, playbooks, webinars, POVs).
* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities through value realization and stakeholder relationships.

 **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in either; Business Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, Data/Analytics, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years in technical consulting across digital strategy, data, integrations, BI/analytics.
* Proven team leadership experience (mentoring juniors, leading small delivery squads).
* Hands\-on proficiency in data platforms \& BI (e.g., SQL, dbt, Snowflake/BigQuery/Azure Synapse; Power BI/Tableau/Looker).
* Experience with system deployments and integrations (APIs, ETL/ELT, CI/CD fundamentals).
* Strong grasp of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance implications.
* Excellent stakeholder management: translating business needs into technical solutions and vice versa.
* Demonstrated business development support (solutioning, scoping, proposal creation).
* Exposure to CRM/ERP/MarTech platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Adobe, HubSpot) or experience with cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) and containerized deployments is desirable
* Familiarity with advanced analytics/ML pipelines or customer data platforms (CDP).
* Desirable Certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer, Power BI, Salesforce, PMP/Agile).
* Communication \& Report Writing: Strong executive presence, collaborative, creative articulate and concise in key report findings and recommendations.
* Leadership \& Coaching: Always learning, builds capability across the team, and promotes best practices.
* Delivery Discipline: Reliable governance, documentation, and risk management.
* Client focused: Outcome\-driven with the ability to deliver client value and identify new opportunities
* Resilient: Adaptable and confident in high\-pressure environments.

 **Additional Information** *Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.*

*We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.*

**About BHP**  



At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.  



Come and be a part of this success.
About the Role

This role will be based in our Brisbane office and supported by the latest technology to engage with our sites around Australia and the globe.

Reporting to the Lead System Dynamics, your focus areas include:
* Identify capability, performance improvement, and value engineering opportunities across BHP asset value chains over short\-, medium\-, and long term horizons.
* Engage with operations and stakeholders to identify, define, and structure business problems, including context, success measures, constraints, and potential challenges.
* Define modelling purpose and scope, selecting the appropriate modelling approach, level of detail, and data requirements to ensure System Dynamics models are fit for purpose and accurately represent real systems.
* Build, validate, document, and review System Dynamics models in AnyLogic to simulate supply chains, including mine operations, trucking and rail networks, processing plants, and product loading and dispatch.
* Collaborate with site SMEs, data analysts, and data scientists to interrogate and analyse large datasets, extract insights, identify operational and performance issues, and prepare data inputs for dynamic models.
* Define simulation cases, execute scenarios, analyse results, and create visualisations to communicate insights, findings, and recommendations that inform decision making.
* Set modelling requirements and jointly solve complex value chain problems through collaborative design and problem structuring.
* Develop and use fit for purpose models to test solutions and recommend practical, implementable actions.
* Provide technical support to projects and the team through application of your dynamic simulation expertise.

About You

Essential requirements:  


* Tertiary qualifications in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or analytics\-related discipline, together with a passion for problem solving and using data and dynamic simulation to identify, evaluate and support value engineering and performance improvement initiatives:
* 3\+ years of experience defining and programming discrete\-event simulations in AnyLogic

  


Other attributes you may have would include some or all of the following:  


* Practical experience in mining, minerals processing and resource industries, or equivalent heavy industries, which could include experience in operations or consulting in these areas;
* Experience in value engineering and performance improvement ideation and hypothesis development, including exploring and proposing new ideas that may have benefits for the operation and business;
* Strong critical thinking and creative problem solving skills to generate value through simulation, while maintaining a practical and strategic focus;
* Capability in project scoping and executing work using a disciplined approach to attain project goals;
* Strong presentation and communication skills, and ability to influence stakeholders with different areas of expertise and experience
**About Our Process**  



At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks.  


*If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal.*  


**Supporting a Diverse Workforce**  


The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance\-based bonuses and a best\-in\-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms.  



At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity employer that is committed to making BHP a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and be at their best every day. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and recognise that true diversity includes gender, age, race, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, education levels, and many more aspects of your identity.  



BHP is committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible for all. If you have a disability, we know that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. If you would like to reach out to someone about your situation and our recruitment process, please email us at ***inclusion@bhp.com***.

title: 2027 Australian Government Graduate Program
description:
* Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Geospatial Analysts, Mathematicians/Statisticians and more \- Over 170 Data roles across Australia
* Starting salary between $69,761 \- $94,270, plus superannuation
* Unlock opportunities with more than 30 Australian Government agencies \& departments

  

  

**Become a Data Graduate in the Australian Government**  

  

Are you passionate about data and ready to use your skills to build a better Australia?  

  

The Australian Government Graduate Program (AGGP) – Data Stream, led by the Australian Bureau of Statistics, is offering approximately 170 permanent roles across more than 30 Australian Government and Commonwealth agencies. This is your chance to launch a career in data that shapes the nation.  

  

As a Data Graduate, you’ll play a vital role in shaping decisions that impact millions of Australians — while kickstarting a career that matters.  

  

**Why join us?**  

The Australian Government is the largest graduate recruiter in the country, giving you access to some of Australia’s most unique and powerful datasets. As a graduate, you will:

  

* gain access to more than 30 different departments and agencies
* step into a permanent, full time role with job security
* enjoy generous leave entitlements
* be valued for your fresh perspective and diverse views
* contribute to all aspects of government, including policy development, program management and service delivery
* receive formal training, mentorship, and on the job learning
* earn a competitive salary while making a real difference.


  

**Our workplace culture**  

In the Australian Government we are committed to creating a workplace where people feel valued, supported and able to do their best work. Drawn from the latest 2025 APS Employee Census, see how employees experience our culture every day.  

* 88% strongly believe in the purpose and objectives of their agency
* 88% feel committed to their agency’s goals
* 84% feel their agency actively promotes an inclusive workplace culture
* 86% are satisfied with job stability and security
* 85% are satisfied with non monetary conditions, including leave and flexible work
* 87% say their supervisor cares about their health and wellbeing
* 91% feel motivated to go the extra mile.


  

**Where you can work**
Opportunities are available in Canberra, with additional roles in Melbourne, Sydney, Adelaide, Brisbane, and Perth.
  

  

Limited positions may be available in Darwin, Geelong, Hobart, Newcastle, Townsville, as well as a small number in Alice Springs, Penrith, Richmond, Robina and Albury.  

**Choose your data role**  

Which data path excites you most?  

  

Data Generalist  

Roles include Data Analysts, Geospatial Analysts, Data Engineers and Data Managers. Data Generalists lead the design, analysis and delivery of relevant, trusted and objective statistics and data\-related insights.
  

  

*See what Data Generalists do here.*  

  

  

Data Scientist  

Roles include Applied Data Scientists, Data Science Developers and Data Modellers. Data Scientists apply advanced analytics techniques and scientific principles to extract valuable information from data for business decision\-making, strategic planning and more.  

  

*See what Data Scientists do here.*  

  

  

Mathematician/Statistician  

Roles include Statisticians, Mathematicians and Evaluation Specialists. Mathematicians/Statisticians provide expert advice on statistical methods used to produce high quality official statistics and generate timely new insights. Mathematicians/Statisticians identify, research, implement and maintain a range of innovative statistical solutions to embrace new data sources and methodologies.  

  

*See what Mathematicians/Statisticians do here.*  

  

  

**Are you eligible?**  

To be eligible for the program you must:

  

* be an Australian citizen at the time of application
* have completed at least an Australian Qualifications Framework Level 7 qualification (a Bachelor’s degree) or higher qualification between 1 January 2022 and 31 December 2026
* be able to obtain and maintain a valid Australian Government security clearance, if required
* be willing to undergo any necessary police, character, health or other checks as required.

  

**Program highlights**  

The participating agencies in the Data Stream work on some of the most meaningful challenges facing Australia today. As a data graduate, you can contribute to initiatives that shape communities, protect the environment, support wellbeing and drive the nation’s future.
  

  

While the range of opportunities is vast, graduates are placed in agencies focused on areas such as:

  

* Environment, climate and natural resources
* Health, social services and aged care
* Governance, law, integrity and the public sector
* Education, employment and workforce development
* Security and defence
* Industry, infrastructure and communication
* Economy, finance and taxation
* Data, statistics and analytical services


  

**More information**  

For detailed information, view the *Information for Applicants* guide and *Frequently Asked Questions* linked below.  

  

The Recruitment team will be hosting an Ask Me Anything session on ***Tuesday 10 March from 5:00pm to 6:00pm (AEDT)*** via Microsoft Teams. You’ll get to meet the Data Stream recruitment team and ask any questions you have about the recruitment process. **Join the session here**!  

  

**Apply now**  

Applications close **11:30pm (AEDT), Tuesday 31 March 2026**. Late applications will not be accepted.

title: Generative AI Data Scientist
description:
Fractal Analytics is a strategic AI partner to Fortune 500 companies with a vision to power every human decision in the enterprise. Fractal is building a world where individual choices, freedom, and diversity are the greatest assets. An ecosystem where human imagination is at the heart of every decision. Where no possibility is written off, only challenged to get better. We believe that a true Fractalite empowers imagination with intelligence. And that it will be such Fractalites that will continue to build the company for the next 100 years.
 



 Please visit Fractal \| Intelligence for Imagination for more information about Fractal.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a seasoned AI Data Scientist to lead our efforts in leveraging Generative AI and advanced analytics to optimize lead generation strategies. This role blends deep technical expertise in machine learning and AI with strategic leadership and business acumen. You will guide cross\-functional teams to build intelligent systems that enhance customer acquisition, personalize outreach, and improve conversion rates.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership** 



* Lead AI\-driven initiatives focused on lead generation, customer segmentation, and personalization.
* Translate business goals into data science strategies and scalable solutions.
* Mentor junior data scientists and foster a culture of innovation and experimentation.



**Technical Execution** 



* Design and deploy ML models for lead scoring, churn prediction, and campaign optimization.
* Develop GenAI\-powered tools (e.g., LLM\-based chatbots, content generators) to support marketing and sales.
* Build and maintain robust data pipelines and ML workflows using cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).



**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with marketing, sales, and product teams to align AI solutions with business needs.
* Present insights and model outcomes to stakeholders in a clear, actionable manner.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and ethical AI standards.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in data science, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
* Proven track record in deploying AI/ML solutions for lead generation or customer acquisition.
* Expertise in Python, R, SQL, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
* Experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering).
* Strong understanding of marketing funnels, CRM systems, and customer lifecycle analytics.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar.
* Experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and uplift modeling.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Pay:** 




 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Fractal, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: $165,000 \- $198,000\. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus for the current performance period.
 



  





**Benefits:** 




 As a full\-time employee of the company or as an hourly employee working more than 30 hours per week, you will be eligible to participate in the health, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability plans in accordance with the plan documents, which may be amended from time to time. You will be eligible for benefits on the first day of employment with the Company. In addition, you are eligible to participate in the Company 401(k) Plan after 30 days of employment, in accordance with the applicable plan terms. title: Data Scientist
description:
**About Atticus**
 At any given time, 16 million Americans are experiencing a crisis that requires urgent help from our legal system or government. The right assistance could transform their lives. But today, most never get it.
   

  

 Atticus makes it easy for any sick or injured person in crisis to get the life\-changing aid they deserve. In the last six years, we’ve become the leading platform connecting people with disabilities to government benefits. We also help victims of accidents, misconduct, and violence get compensation from insurance.
   

  

 So far, we’ve helped hundreds of thousands of people access over $10B in life\-changing aid —and earned over 17,000\+ five\-star reviews. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We've raised more than $100 million from top VC firms like Fika, Forerunner, GV (Google Ventures), and True Ventures, with ambitions to create a category defining business assisting needy Americans. (We closed our Series C round in April 2025, so we're well\-funded for the foreseeable future.) In 2025, our team grew from 151 to 210, and we will grow again in 2026\.
   

  

**The Job**
 Our business generates a wealth of data with untapped potential to support people in need of aid, and improve their likelihood of positive outcomes in the legal system. Our platform covers a lot: evaluating a client’s case, giving advice, matching them with the right lawyer, formalizing the arrangement, and helping both parties work together as the case progresses. The data we generate across this end\-to\-end journey provides a unique opportunity to improve client experiences at a national scale for the legal practice areas we support, using novel data unavailable to other industry actors (individual law firms, government agencies).
   

  

 We are looking for Data Scientists to join our team and leverage this data to fulfill our mission. You’ll help establish the central Data Science team and embed closely with departments within Atticus to help us better apply data across all areas of our platform.
   

  

 Serve as a founding member of the company’s data science function, building a culture of collaboration, growth, and excellence that will attract talent for years to come
   

  

* Design metrics, build data pipelines, run experiments, launch models – apply a broad toolkit to expansive data from a rapidly growing business
* Work closely with department leads and their teams to ensure our decision\-making and operations are data\-informed
* Interpret data as the collective voice of our clients, generating insights that inform our product roadmap and user experience
* Hold teams accountable to measurable impact, enabling them to identify and target their most effective levers to improve the business


 The role is a rare opportunity to join a fast\-growing Series B startup that doubles as a B\-corp social enterprise. Every project you take on will help clients in need get the help they deserve, and you’ll shape our company culture as we scale. We’re looking for data scientists who are excited about our mission and the challenges it entails.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* You have 4\+ years of relevant industry experience at a high\-growth startup, or scrappy team at a larger company
* You’re eager to jump in and serve as the primary data thought partner for a cross\-functional team working on a novel and quickly evolving problem space
* You’re excited about providing “full\-stack” data support covering metric \& data model design, exploratory analysis, testing \& experimentation, and predictive modeling
* You’re fluent in SQL, and have substantial professional experience with Python or R
* You’ve built key metrics, reporting, and models from scratch for a product or business domain
* You’ve leveraged A/B testing or causal inference methods to help teams identify and target their most effective levers


 Bonus / Nice\-to\-Have:
   

  

* You have experience working on a two\-sided marketplace
* You have experience with non\-experimental causal inference methods
* You’ve shipped and maintained model code in a production environment


 We are strongly committed to building a diverse team. If you’re from a background that’s underrepresented in tech, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

**Salary And Benefits**
 This is a rare opportunity to join a startup that has strong traction (substantial funding, well\-respected backers, tremendous growth, and many happy customers) but is still small enough that you can have a huge impact and play a role in shaping our culture.
   

  

 We’re a certified B Corporation tackling a critical social problem. Our mission to help people in need drives everything we do, and your work here will touch many lives.
   

  

 We offer competitive pay — including equity — and generous benefits:
   

  

* Medical and dental insurance with 100% of employee premiums covered
* 15 vacation days \& \~20 paid holidays each year (including two weeks at end\-of\-year)
* Free membership to OneMedical
* $600/year reimbursable stipend for internet service
* $1,000 reimbursable stipend for education and training outside of work
* Up to $1,200/year student loan repayment assistance
* 401(k) and optional HSA/FSA
* Humble, thoughtful, smart, fun colleagues


 We anticipate the base salary band for this role will be between $150,000 and $200,000 in addition to equity and benefits. The salary at offer will be determined by a number of factors such as candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.
   

  

**Location**
 This job is fully remote and we’re committed to empowering everyone with flexibility. Work remotely, and travel to LA (on the company dime) as needed to be with your colleagues – usually quarterly, plus offsites. We care a lot about building a great culture and we think some interactions need to happen in person, so we put a lot of thought into retreats, offsites, and other ways to gather.
